title: Which tools would make running your pub easier?
intro: We run our own pub, The Anchor in Stanwell Moor, and we build software. We're planning a set of simple tools for independent pubs, and we'd rather the trade told us which to build first than guess. About three minutes, mostly taps.
shareText: Which tools would make running your pub easier? A quick survey for licensees, about three minutes.
thankYouBody: Every answer goes into deciding what we build first. The more pubs that answer, the clearer the picture, so if you know another licensee, send them the link.

results.heading: What the trade has picked so far

consentText: I'm happy for Orange Jelly to contact me about these tools. I can ask you to stop at any time.

questions.prompt: Customers and bookings: which of these would you use?
questions.hint: Pick up to three, or none.

options.label: Customer list
options.hint: Sign-ups, birthdays, offers clubs and who comes in when

options.label: Table bookings
options.hint: A booking button for your website, with deposits and reminders

options.label: Event bookings
options.hint: Quiz nights and live music, with tickets or deposits

options.label: Private parties
options.hint: Party enquiries, quotes, deposits and run sheets

options.label: Parking bookings
options.hint: Let people book and pay for spaces in your car park

options.label: Email and text campaigns
options.hint: Message the right customers, like everyone who booked Mother's Day last year

options.label: Review replies
options.hint: See and answer your Google reviews in one place

questions.prompt: Running the pub: which of these would you use?
questions.hint: Pick up to three, or none.

options.label: Daily checks
options.hint: Opening, closing, cellar and fridge temperature checks, with photos

options.label: Staff records
options.hint: Contracts, right-to-work documents, training and expiry reminders

options.label: Recruitment
options.hint: A jobs page, applications and trial shifts in one place

options.label: Staff rotas
options.hint: Rotas, availability, shift swaps and holiday requests

options.label: Receipts and expenses
options.hint: Receipts, mileage, petty cash and a monthly pack for your accountant

options.label: Stock and ordering
options.hint: Stock counts, par levels and supplier orders

options.label: Tips and tronc
options.hint: Share tips fairly and keep a record of it
